purpose: Explain observed B false alarms/missed errors and propose a bounded prospective validation-only scoring experiment.

saved_120_case_B_word_review.definition: Shared full39 dictionary-variant sequence-review panel. Gold uses explicit expert word_index only. This is not the deployed posterior policy or the research scorer's differently mapped WORD counters.

false_positive_words_with_manual_canonic.scope: Compared expert canonical phone sequence for each false-positive word against every existing CMU variant. This is not an oracle alignment or proof that the remaining 149 errors originate only in the encoder.

interpretation: DH->D and Z->S appear both as false alarms and as missed actual expert errors. Treating those contrasts as always acceptable would hide genuine errors.
Existing dictionary variants explain only a small measured portion of these false-positive words. More dictionary entries alone are unlikely to resolve the main failure pattern.
151 false-positive words contain 174 edit events; event counts are not interchangeable with word counts.
TLV has 20 recordings from one Vietnamese speaker; its FPR is 19/68 and recall 103/137. This cannot establish general Vietnamese-accent population performance.

Six expert insertion events have no explicit word_index. Shared-review gold omits these six at word level, while phone metrics retain them. Never mix its 461 error-word denominator with research WORD counters.

cached_validation_feasibility.format: NumPy NPZ, log_probs float32 (frames by 83 labels), JSON metadata; allow_pickle=False
cached_validation_feasibility.AUC_scope: Continuous-score separation among eligible labelled words only, with tied ranks. Not a calibrated probability, deployment accuracy or full-word coverage result.

old_grid_audit.scope: Read-only analysis of existing validation grid; no new thresholds selected or enabled.

cached_validation_feasibility.calibration_status: failed/ineligible; no accepted thresholds; current categorical policy abstains
cached_validation_feasibility.current_method: ctc_variant_posterior_margin_v1: negative 20th percentile of forced-reference phone mean nonblank-competitor margins
method_limitations: This is an experimental feature, not the exact published CTC-GOP formula.
A forced reference Viterbi path is not proof that the learner realized that phone. CTC peaks can occupy very few frames.
Structural insertions/deletions make many words ineligible; a policy ignoring these cases would improve apparent precision while losing error coverage.
The B checkpoint was selected using all 450 validation utterances. PNV is held out from threshold fitting, not from earlier checkpoint selection.
cached_validation_feasibility.test_posterior_availability: The 120-case comparison stored decoded phones but discarded posterior matrices. GOP cannot be reconstructed from decoded phones. A separately authorized B forward pass is needed to cache the 120 matrices; the previous 120 inference total was approximately 9.17 GPU seconds, excluding orchestration, I/O and load. No such pass was started in this audit.

proposed_bounded_experiment.type: New frozen scoring/calibration comparison on the existing B weights; not neural fine-tuning
pre_registration: Freeze exact candidate scoring formulas, source revisions, cache hashes, labels, fit/heldout IDs, gating policy, threshold grid and tie-break rules before computing candidate heldout/test scores.
Use cached HJK/LXC validation posteriors for scorer/threshold selection only. Choose a bounded set of formulas, not an open-ended search.

One possible bounded set: identical current dictionary-variant edit baseline; current q20 margin; two predeclared margin aggregations such as mean and minimum; a published CTC-GOP implementation only if faithfully ported and tested against its original formula. A truncated/local approximation must be named as a separate experimental scorer.
Retain all accepted dictionary variants symmetrically. Do not declare DH/D, Z/S, or Vietnamese-accent substitutions always acceptable merely to reduce false positives.

Keep structural insertion/deletion abstentions explicit until a separately evaluated scorer supports them. Report correct/error coverage separately and retain unknown labels, OOVs and alignment failures in denominator accounting.
selection_and_audit: Within HJK/LXC, optionally use the two speakers as reciprocal validation folds to pick one registered scorer; refit its scalar thresholds on all 300 fit recordings afterward.
Freeze that single scorer and thresholds before one PNV audit. If the registered FPR/FNR/coverage criteria fail, mark it ineligible and do not quietly loosen thresholds or continue searching on PNV.

Only after freezing the method and its eligibility decision, apply it once to the same locked 120 cases. No 120-case labels, top-error word lists or per-speaker test outcomes may set thresholds or choose among scoring candidates.
The 120 cases and their failure patterns are already observed and have informed this audit; describe the next comparison as exploratory known-test evaluation, not fresh blind confirmatory evidence.
Do not auto-promote a scorer into the demo. Preserve the existing research baseline and record exactly what improved: false alarms, recall, coverage, unsupported cases and latency.
metrics: Native expert original-inventory phone F1/PER retained as the recognition baseline; scoring-only changes do not magically improve those decoded phones.
Word-level TP/FP/FN/TN with one predeclared, shared treatment of unmapped expert insertion events.
FPR and recall on decided/available words, recall on all expert errors, overall/correct/error coverage, calibrated decision counts and per-speaker breakdown.
Paired comparison against the same fixed baseline on identical rows, plus individual examples and all raw posterior/feature identities.
can_compute_without_neural_inference_now: Exact same baseline dictionary-variant edit review on 450 validation recordings.
New deterministic posterior-derived features and their HJK/LXC fit diagnostics, without loading audio encoders.
Implementation/unit tests of log-sum-exp CTC paths and supported phone edits against small exhaustive synthetic examples.
Validation-only scalar threshold search and frozen PNV audit after prospective registration.
requires_separate_model_inference_slot: Caching B posteriors for the fixed 120 test recordings; decoded sequences alone are insufficient.
Any new Hugging Face pronunciation model comparison or audio feature extraction not already cached.

primary_method_sources.title: CTC-GOP: An approach to pronunciation assessment based on CTC
